caseStudy.problem: Organizational departments and client entities suffered from untracked equipment loss, manual spreadsheet discrepancies, delayed maintenance schedules, and maintaining separate codebase deployments across multiple physical locations.

architectureDetails.databaseSchema: Single codebase multi-tenant relational schema normalizing Asset Master, Category Trees, Location Hubs, Maintenance Audits, and Transfer Logs with dynamic tenant scoping and historical transaction isolation.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Handling concurrent asset transfer requests across multiple tenant organizations running on a single unified codebase without cross-tenant data leaks or race conditions.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Implemented dynamic tenant middleware scoping paired with PostgreSQL row locking (`select_for_update`) within atomic Django transactions, guaranteeing immutable tenant asset movement logs.

caseStudy.impact: Streamlined asset tracking for 1,000+ organizational items across 4 tenant departments on a single codebase deployment, reducing audit cycle times by 65% and eliminating unrecorded equipment loss.
